title: Clearer maps
changes: The war table now shows where you are: a pulsing marker on your territory, your land lit up, and "You: territory, land" under the map and in the side panel.

The gates between lands are drawn as gate pairs with a dotted road and the gate's name. Click or hover a territory to see the way there from where you stand: a gold path on the table and the steps (gates, portal stones you have woken) in the side panel.

The zone map names every gate and portal stone with the land and territory it leads to, outlines the territory you are in, and lets you click a territory to pick it. The War table / Zone map button swaps between the two and keeps your pick.
